title: Bouncy Samphire Stir Fry with Ethiopian Spice
description: A flavorful stir fry with bouncy and samphire, seasoned with ethiopian spices. Enjoy as a side dish or add to your favorite meal.

ingredients.name: samphire
ingredients.notes: trim the ends and cut into 5cm pieces

ingredients.name: bouncy
ingredients.notes: soak in water for at least 4 hours

ingredients.name: ethiopian spice blend
ingredients.notes: available at most international grocery stores

ingredients.name: fatty
ingredients.notes: use a neutral oil like canola or grapeseed

instructions: Heat the fatty in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the bouncy and cook for 5-7 minutes, until tender and lightly browned.
Add the samphire to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, until it starts to brown.
Add the ethiopian spice blend to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the flavors have melded together.
Serve hot, garnished with additional samphire if desired.
